item.title: Rallying Cry – November 28, 2026
item.description: Uganda is making strides with the first African trial of an mRNA Ebola vaccine, while Nigeria’s Maria Wophill shines as the 2026 World Athletics Woman of the Year, and a football team’s inspiring comeback after tragedy reminds us of resilience.
